development_disclosure: This design responds to review of PR #131 at 22f41e0. The original nine-arm record is already observed and preserved unchanged. Tie tolerance, promotion cutoff, cached optimizer accounting, resolution diagnostics and lazy shared setup are corrected before one separately committed campaign. This is a post-review diagnostic, not blind preregistration, an independent statistical replica, or a robustness survey.

protocol.candidate_order: singles lexicographic, support lexicographic, creation partition lexicographic, +/-
protocol.selection: first pool member within absolute 1e-10 of the maximum absolute derivative; repeats allowed
protocol.stopping: full pool gradient L2 norm <= threshold, otherwise iteration budget
protocol.optimization: L-BFGS-B, existing minimize_energy; zero-append/full reoptimization; cache identical parameter tuples per round; charge computed energy/gradient calls separately from callback requests
protocol.mixed_rule: OVP screening; promote to independent QEs only when at least two same-support QE derivatives exceed 1e-7; otherwise keep OVP
protocol.parent_gradients: reconstruct from already evaluated OVP +/- derivatives; promotion cutoff 1e-7 = 10 optimizer_gtol = gradient_threshold/10, not a finite-shot or residual uncertainty certificate
protocol.target: first retained trajectory prefix at or below target; reference floor separately; no interpolation or pooled winner
protocol.circuit_accounting: upper bound from independent Pauli parity ladders; no optimized CEO circuit compilation
protocol.quantum_shots: unmeasured, null; no finite-shot certification or hardware claim
protocol.optimizer_resolution: max absolute final derivative <= optimizer_gtol (unconstrained L-BFGS-B); retain L2 separately
protocol.dense_storage: per-arm H plus screening and appended generator matrices; case setup and cache shared across arms; logical arm requirement, not process RSS

claim_boundary: Post-review exact small-sector simulation of QE, OVP-only and mixed CEO with a common optimizer. Declared tolerance and promotion cutoff, observed computed-call ledgers and generic Pauli-ladder upper bounds only. Existing original outcomes informed corrections; no blind preregistration, cross-platform bitwise identity, optimized CEO circuit, finite-shot, hardware, global-optimum or quantum-advantage claim. Config carries no solver outcome.
